title: Landscape lockup / Clear space
slide_intent: Define relationships inside and around a lockup because consistency depends on alignment as well as individual assets.
strategic_value: A stable Duo-to-wordmark relationship can make supplied Duolingo signatures repeatable.
demonstration: An annotated lockup explains body alignment with the g loop, head alignment with the l, a half-x-height gap and an exclusion area.
practical_value: Check both internal spacing and external clearance before placing the lockup.

content_islands.name: Construction diagram
content_islands.spec: Place the annotated Duo and wordmark alignment in the large left panel.

content_islands.name: Alignment and exclusion rules
content_islands.spec: In the right column, put the body, head and gap instructions above the prohibition on objects in the exclusion zone.

reference_purposes.Application: The diagram and copy specify body, head and gap relationships.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Duo and the wordmark are separated by half the x-height, and objects cannot enter the shown clear space.

ingredient.name: Landscape lockup geometry
ingredient.role: Hold mascot and name in a stable relationship.
ingredient.application: Align Duo’s body bottom with the g loop interior and head side with the l top; leave half the x-height between mascot and name and preserve the shown exclusion zone.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical landscape lockup; the half-x-height value describes the internal gap.
